title: Evaluable Language-Model Treatment Policies for Sepsis Resuscitation via Offline Value-Guided Selection
abstract: arXiv:2611.30951v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Offline treatment learning must balance imitation, which stays close to logged evidence but ignores outcomes, against value maximisation, which uses outcomes but drifts toward treatments the records cannot verify. Numerical reinforcement learning strikes this balance during training. For large language models (LLMs), directly using sparse retrospective outcomes for fine-tuning raises challenges of delayed credit assignment and limited evidence for alternative treatments. We present R-LLMC, which strikes the balance at inference for sepsis resuscitation. A behaviour-supervised LLM, decoded into an exact distribution over 25 vasopressor-fluid actions, proposes clinician-anchored candidates; an offline critic selects among them by estimated long-term value. The policy has a closed form for off-policy evaluation, and its rationale is written after selection, so explanation cannot steer treatment. In experiments on held-out MIMIC-III patients

translated_title: 基于离线价值引导选择的可评估脓毒症复苏语言模型治疗策略
translated_abstract: 离线治疗学习必须在模仿与价值最大化之间取得平衡：模仿紧贴已记录的证据但忽略治疗结果，而价值最大化虽然利用治疗结果，却可能漂移向记录无法验证的治疗方案。数值强化学习在训练阶段实现这种平衡。对于大型语言模型（LLM），直接使用稀疏的回顾性治疗结果进行微调会带来延迟信用分配以及替代治疗方案证据有限等挑战。我们提出R-LLMC，在脓毒症复苏任务中于推理阶段实现这种平衡。一个由行为监督的LLM被解码为25种升压药-补液动作上的精确分布，据此提出以临床医生实践为锚点的候选治疗方案；离线评论家根据估计的长期价值在候选方案中进行选择。该策略具有可用于离线策略评估的闭式解，且其解释是在选择之后生成的，因此解释无法反向引导治疗决策。在留出的MIMIC-III患者上的实验中……
tldr: 提出R-LLMC框架，在脓毒症复苏中于推理阶段平衡模仿与价值最大化：行为监督的LLM提出以临床医生为锚的候选治疗方案，离线评论家按估计的长期价值进行选择，该策略具有闭式离线评估形式，且解释生成于选择之后以避免解释引导治疗。
en_tdlr: R-LLMC balances imitation and value maximization at inference time for sepsis resuscitation, where a behavior-supervised LLM proposes clinician-anchored treatment candidates and an offline critic selects among them by estimated long-term value, yielding a policy with closed-form off-policy evaluation and rationale written only after selection.
